goal: Build the 2048 game as a web app, on a 4 by 4 board. A new game starts with two tiles. The arrow keys slide and merge the tiles as in 2048, and a new tile appears after each move that changes the board. The page shows "Score: N" (starting at "Score: 0"), where merging two tiles adds the value of the new tile, and "Moves: N" (starting at "Moves: 0"), the number of arrow-key presses. A button labelled "New game" starts over. A button labelled "Save score" stores the current score on the server; the page shows the highest stored score as "Best: N", which is "Best: 0" before any score is stored and is shown when the page loads. The best score is kept when the server restarts.
